subject: Renewal: Staggered Roadmap Demo & exec runbook — availability check
messages:
From: Megan Clark <megan@orthomed.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orthomed.com
Date: 2028-08-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — two-window ask

Hi Jonas,

Hope you're well — our renewal with Redwood is coming up and we'd like to lock in the QBR/roadmap demo. We have two groups that need attention:

- Execs (VP/Product, CTO) — 30–45 minutes focused on roadmap, business impact, and the proposed renewal terms.
- Technical team (SRE + ML infra) — 60 minutes deep dive with specific questions about dedicated capacity, latency SLOs, and the private deployment checklist.

Can you propose two distinct windows (one that works for our execs in US Eastern and an alternate that works for the tech team in US Pacific)? Ideally next week (Aug 22–24). Also: can you share an "exec runbook" (high-level slide + timeline) and a separate tech runbook or outline we can circulate?

Attendees: Megan Clark (VP Product), Aaron Li (CTO), procurement@orthomed.com, L1 SRE lead (TBD).

Thanks — if you can propose slots and attach the runbook drafts, we can pick and I will send calendar invites.

Best,
Megan Clark
VP, Product — OrthoMed

Attachment: QBR_agenda_v1.pdf (agenda draft)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Megan Clark <megan@orthomed.com>
Cc: procurement@orthomed.com
Date: 2028-08-17T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — two-window ask

Thanks Megan — appreciate the clarity.

Proposed approach: split into two linked sessions same day or adjacent days:
- Exec QBR (30–40m): product/roadmap + commercial summary + top-line SLOs and guarantees.
- Technical deep dive (60m): infra, dedicated capacity, private deployment checklist, and a short ops runbook.

Proposed windows (all in ET / PT equivalents):
1) Tue Aug 22 — Exec QBR 11:00–11:40 ET (08:00–08:40 PT) + Tech deep dive 15:00–16:00 ET (12:00–13:00 PT)
2) Wed Aug 23 — Exec QBR 09:30–10:10 ET (06:30–07:10 PT) + Tech deep dive 13:00–14:00 ET (10:00–11:00 PT)

If you'd prefer we can also do Exec + Tech on the same block back-to-back.

I attached two files: runbook_proposal_v1.docx (30m exec runbook + checklist) and qbr_agenda_v1.pdf (your agenda from the note). I can tailor the runbook to include an "escalation path" and a short slide on cost/quantization options for the tech audience.

One ask from my side: who will own the procurement timeline on your side so I can route a short addendum/term sheet for the exec meeting? Also let me know if Aaron (CTO) wants a specific SLA item called out.

If those windows look ok I'll send calendar invites and a separate calendar hold for the tech deep dive.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: runbook_proposal_v1.docx
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record-67890

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-08-17T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: OrthoMed QBR — who owns what (exec runbook + tech backup)

Team — tagging quickly to lock roles if we go with Tue Aug 22 (preferred by client).

Quick asks:
- Laura: would you lead the exec portion and own the commercial bullets + term addendum? (30–40m)
- Marcus: can you be tech lead for the deep dive (12:00–13:00 PT slot) and prep the private-deploy checklist?
- Tessa: can you host the calendar invites and own the run-of-show / breakout rooms? Also be backup presenter if Laura gets pulled.

I've attached the runbook_proposal_v1.docx. Please review pages 2–4 (timings + slide ownership). If Marcus can add two slides about autoscaling policies and KV cache behavior that'd be ideal — keep them high-level for execs, more detail for the tech session.

I'll send the two candidate slots to the customer, but only after I hear from you on availability. If someone can't make Tue 11:00 ET / 15:00 ET blocks, say so now.

Calendar poll (internal): https://doodle.com/poll/orthomed-qbr-internal

Thanks — short turnaround on this one.
Jonas

Attachment: runbook_proposal_v1.docx

From: Megan Clark <megan@orthomed.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@orthomed.com
Date: 2028-08-18T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — two-window ask

Jonas — thanks for the quick turnaround and the runbook. Tue Aug 22 works for the exec group; Aaron can make the 11:00–11:40 ET slot. The tech team prefers Wed but Aaron wants the exec briefing first, so we can do:

- Tue Aug 22 11:00–11:40 ET — Exec QBR (Jonas/Laura lead; Aaron + Megan + Procurement)
- Wed Aug 23 13:00–14:00 ET — Tech deep dive (Marcus lead; SREs + ML infra)

If you can send two calendar invites (one for each session) and a short one-page exec runbook we can circulate internally, I'll confirm attendees and share the SRE lead name. Also can procurement expect a short addendum to review after the exec? If yes please send to procurement@orthomed.com.

Appreciate it — will look for invites.

Best,
Megan
VP, Product — OrthoMed
